findings.evidence: The r4 snapshot claims a canonical committed v1.4.505 build that produced `latest-linux.yml` and passed package validation, but the current proof chain is incomplete: `release/latest-linux.yml` and `release/flowstate-truth-ledger.json` now reflect v1.4.505, while the only persisted local release receipt is still `release/flowstate-release-receipt.json` for v1.4.503 and the shared challenge evidence note still describes v1.4.504. Static inspection proves the gate exists and the current packaged artifacts line up with the snapshot hashes, but no refreshed 1.4.505 receipt or validator-success artifact currently proves the claimed package-validation pass for this exact build.
findings.remediation: Refresh the 1.4.505 release evidence with a new receipt or other persisted validator-success artifact bound to the current clean build, then resnapshot/re-review against that exact artifact set.

remaining_risks: Installed-app retry remains unproven in this read-only review: no current evidence shows an installed 1.4.502 desktop app discovering 1.4.505, downloading it, relaunching, and reporting 1.4.505 without a new failed marker.
Public updater read-back was not re-fetched live during this isolated review; manifest and artifact availability were assessed from the local packaged artifacts only.

reviewer.isolation_evidence: Inspected only the supplied r4 snapshot plus the bounded local source, test, and release artifacts needed to evaluate its four acceptance items: electron/updater.ts, scripts/validate-electron-package.cjs, scripts/run-electron-builder-with-npm-tree.sh, package.json, tests/unit/electron/appimage-installer-transaction-runtime.test.ts, tests/unit/electron/updater-pending.test.ts, tests/unit/electron/updater-auth-durability.test.ts, tests/unit/scripts/validate-electron-package.test.ts, release/latest-linux.yml, release/linux-unpacked/resources/app.asar, release/flowstate-truth-ledger.json, release/flowstate-release-receipt.json, and docs/challenge/evidence-2026-09-02-bug-2071-release.md. Ran no tests and made no edits.

evidence.result: The bounded updater tests named in the current challenge evidence still match the acceptance: the durable-auth suite keeps the explicit retry path that clears the blocked marker for the running version, performs one fresh update check, and downloads the newer version, while the paired pending-marker suite still preserves scoped cleanup for failed and resolved markers.

The packaged-updater gate is present and specifically targeted: `scripts/validate-electron-package.cjs` extracts `dist-electron/updater.js` from the sealed package and requires the exact whitespace-stripping and full `appVersion` token matcher, while the bounded validator regression suite still rejects the pre-fix grep verifier and accepts fixtures containing the exact direct-provenance predicate.

The current packaged state is close to the claim: `release/latest-linux.yml` exists and now reports v1.4.505, `release/linux-unpacked/resources/app.asar` matches the r4 snapshot hash, and `release/flowstate-truth-ledger.json` is clean and consistent at the r4 source revision. But no refreshed persisted artifact currently proves that package validation passed for this exact 1.4.505 build: the only local release receipt remains pinned to v1.4.503, and the shared challenge evidence note still describes v1.4.504.
